description: Add sensitive path blocking rules to _redirects and missing security headers to _headers. These are static file changes for Cloudflare Pages.
steps: In apps/frontend/public/_redirects, add a new comment block '# Block sensitive paths - return 404 for common attack vectors' BEFORE the existing trailing-slash rules, followed by rules for: /.env, /.env.*, /.git/*, /.htaccess, /.DS_Store, /.svn/*, /wp-admin, /wp-login.php, /server-status, /phpinfo.php, /web.config, /wrangler.toml, /package.json, /tsconfig.json, /Dockerfile, /docker-compose.yml, /.dockerignore. Each rule format: '/path /index.html 404'

In apps/frontend/public/_headers, add six new headers to the existing /* block (after the existing Permissions-Policy line): X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block, X-DNS-Prefetch-Control: on, X-Download-Options: noopen, X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: none, Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin, Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: credentialless
acceptance_criteria: apps/frontend/public/_redirects starts with the sensitive path blocking rules followed by trailing-slash rules
apps/frontend/public/_headers /* block contains all 6 new security headers in addition to the existing ones
The existing Cache-Control blocks and route-specific headers remain unchanged
verification: Visually inspect _redirects to confirm 17 blocking rules appear before the 12 trailing-slash rules
Visually inspect _headers to confirm the /* block has all original headers plus the 6 new ones
